founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Luciana is CEO at Cedalio, the AI agent platform for the Office of the CFO. Cedalio automates procurement, accounts payable, and the data flows behind them. Software engineer originally from Argentina, living in the Bay Area since 2018. Previously co-founded Wolox, an end-to-end digital solutions company that was acquired by Accenture in Jan 2021.

Hello! I'm Nico Magni, the Chief Product Officer (CPO) at Cedalio, a database that tracks every application data change, and maintains an immutable and verifiable history. As a software engineer, I am passionate about building innovative solutions that tackle real-world challenges.

launches.title: Cedalio: where sustainability meets data
launches.tagline: Unify, automate, verify — your trusted data platform for ESG
launches.body:
Dear YC Community,

We're elated to present our latest offering. Cedalio's core technology has always been centered around a blockchain-enabled database ensuring data **transparency, verification, and integrity**. With our latest launch, we've taken this a step further.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=75973&key=user_uploads/1337055/0181388c-9132-4361-9ee1-31ad7602713f)

\
Key Features:

* **AI data extraction:** Leverage our AI-powered data extraction capabilities to seamlessly collect information from various sources – from utility bills to supplier forms. Our automated consolidation feature integrates with your existing systems, centralizing all data into a single source of truth. Say goodbye to manual data wrangling and hello to real-time, centralized information.
* **Radical Transparency:** Trust is the foundation of sustainability. Our platform leverages blockchain technology to create an immutable, auditable trail of your data transactions. Enhance transparency and build credibility with stakeholders, knowing your information is accurate, secure, and tamper-proof.
* **AI-Assisted Reporting:** Unlock the power of your data with our AI-assisted reporting tools. Generate comprehensive, auditable reports tailored to your specific needs, or export data in your preferred format for in-depth analysis.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80U2voY6IaU>

The development of our product was largely influenced by the feedback and insights we received from our partners in the traceability sector. Their challenges in ensuring transparent ESG reporting and undeniable proof of product origins drove us to create a solution that addresses these pain points head-on.

We invite you to delve deeper into Cedalio, explore its features, and contact us if you see any way of collaborating.

Warm regards,

The Cedalio Team

launches.title: 💥 Cedalio — A blockchain empowered alternative to Firebase
launches.tagline: Build apps with data that is auditable and verifiable by default
launches.body:
[Cedalio](https://www.cedalio.com) is a platform that helps you build apps with information that is auditable by default. Data used in your application can be traced back to its origin for verification. Even more, with us you can give your users real ownership and portability of their data across different applications.

## 📚 **TL;DR**

* Cedalio provides companies with the tools to build trust and accountability by offering transparent, auditable data.
* With Cedalio, organizations prioritizing user privacy can empower users with true ownership of their data, promoting its portability across various applications.
* By storing access control information on-chain, Cedalio ensures a censorship-resistant database, safeguarding information integrity.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72841&key=user_uploads/1337055/6fdf4c1c-3f4b-474e-89b1-66ff7ef1d6ce)

**_Interested? →_** Get started now at [**www.cedalio.com**](http://www.cedalio.com)\
**Do you have a new use case in mind? →** Let us know on our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/kSdhmb9UUT)\
**_Do you want how it works under the hood? →_** Read our [**DocSite**](https://docs.cedalio.com/introduction/about-cedalio)

## 👩‍💻 **How do we do it:**

* **Verifiable data:** field-level certifications offers a means to validate the data's integrity, creating trust and assurance in the accuracy of the information.
* **On chain access controls**: the access control rules are stored in a smart contract, ensuring a censorship-resistant database.
* **On chain log:** by recording a detailed log of transactions on the blockchain, we enable auditability and the ability to reconstruct the database if needed.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72841&key=user_uploads/1337055/4b89dc51-7589-4412-9563-628a4e601507)
